newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Valley Group names president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Valley Group names president, COO.

text.p: Silicon Valley Group said Wednesday that it has named William Hightower to the newly created positions of president and chief operating officer.
The supplier of automated wafer processing technology for the semiconductor industry said Hightwower will be responsible for the day to day operations of the company's three operating divisions.
The company said that prior to his joining Silicon Valley Group, Hightower was chairman and chief executive officer of Cadnet Corp, a software company based in Atlanta.
In its statement, the company noted that Hightower joined its board of directors in 1994.
